name: LRS3-TED: Large-Scale Audio-Visual and Lip Reading Dataset
description: LRS3-TED is a large-scale multimodal speech benchmark curated by the Visual Geometry Group (VGG) at Oxford in collaboration with Google. Containing over 438 hours of spoken video across 151,338 utterances from 5,000 speakers drawn from TED and TEDx talks, it provides face track coordinates and word-level temporal alignments widely recognized as the preeminent benchmark for visual speech recognition (lip reading) and audio-visual speech processing.
